explication: Video Speed Controller is a browser extension for controlling HTML5 audio and video playback. Its main workflow detects media, applies site-specific handling, attaches an overlay controller, and lets users change playback through keyboard shortcuts or the overlay. Settings, per-site rules, persistent speed, and customized controls are additional product capabilities. The graph reflects documented features and source-index references; some wiring and unsampled subsystem details are not shown, so uncertain connections are omitted.
